title: grove project configuration
description: Machine-local grove.json (or grove.jsonc) that lives at a grove project root (beside the bare .base repo). Declares the recipes grove runs at each point in a branch's lifecycle (hooks), plus a few cross-recipe settings. The .jsonc variant (and either extension) tolerates // and /* */ comments and trailing commas.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema (for editor validation).

copy.description: Untracked files copied from the default-branch worktree into freshly created worktrees.

hooks.description: Recipes grouped by when they run. Naming rule: a "before*" bucket is a gate that runs first and can abort by exiting non-zero; an "on*" bucket is a reaction to an event that already happened (failures only warn).

beforeCreateBranch.description: Runs only when a brand-new branch (neither local nor on origin) is about to be created, before the worktree or branch exist. A non-zero exit aborts creation entirely. Not run by `grove path`, and not run when reusing an existing local/origin branch.

onCreateWorktree.description: Runs once, when a worktree is freshly created - including checking out an existing local/origin branch into a new worktree, not just brand-new branches. Also re-run by `grove open --force` on an existing worktree. Failures warn but don't abort. The bucket for one-time setup (e.g. `yarn install`).

onOpen.description: Runs on every open: creating, reopening, and a plain-folder `grove launch`/`here`. Failures warn but don't abort.

detectSquash.description: Detect squash/rebase-merged branches via patch-equivalence against origin/<default> (default: true).

forge.description: Optionally consult a forge (via the gh CLI) for authoritative merged-PR state.

enabled.description: Enable the gh-based merged-PR lookup (default: false). Requires gh on PATH and authentication for the remote's host.

repo.description: Override the auto-detected host/owner/repo passed to `gh --repo` (e.g. github.com/owner/repo).

type.description: Recipe type. Built-ins: tmux, vscode-color-config, webhook, command, cd. Any other value resolves to grove-recipe-<type> on PATH.

url.description: Target URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:39788/open via a reverse SSH tunnel.

token.description: Shared secret sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Supports $VAR env substitution.

params.description: JSON body to POST. String values support $VAR / ${VAR} substitution from grove context env.

layout.description: tmux panes as name=cmd pairs, comma-separated (e.g. shell=,claude=claude).

command.description: Shell command run through a login shell (e.g. nvm use && yarn install). Runs in the worktree directory, or the project root when placed in beforeCreateBranch (the worktree doesn't exist yet).

shell.description: Login shell used to run the command (default: bash).

then.description: Move the calling shell into the worktree. Requires grove's shell integration (shell/grove.bash or grove.fish) to be sourced; without it grove cannot change your shell's directory.
